name: Field
notes: A continuously running harmonic oscillator network. Each voice has its own natural frequency near a lattice node, mistuned by disorder D. Voices are coupled through their reduced phase phi_i = theta_i / n_i -- the phase of the fundamental each one implies. Coupling K pulls the implied fundamentals together; above a critical K the ensemble spontaneously locks into exact integer ratios and the harmonic series appears without being imposed. The order parameter r is the degree to which the voices agree on a fundamental none of them plays.

paramNotes.K: coupling, rad/s. The field locks around K=1.2 on the way up and holds all the way down to K=0 on the way back. Above K~1.2 a scramble heals; below it, a scramble is permanent.
paramNotes.G: coherence gain. K_eff = K + G*((r-r0)/(1-r0))^2 with r0 = 1/sqrt(N), the incoherent floor. Below K ~ 1.2 the field is bistable: locked and incoherent are both stable, so coherence sustains itself and a scramble destroys it permanently.
paramNotes.T: environment temperature: phase noise. What coherence has to be maintained against.
paramNotes.D: disorder: spread of natural frequencies away from exact lattice nodes.
paramNotes.environment: level of the inharmonic noise bed admitted to the membrane.
paramNotes.membrane: feedback of the comb at 1/f0. Passes harmonics of the fundamental, rejects everything else. Tracks r when auto is on.
paramNotes.glideMs: how long the ensemble takes to slide to a new target fundamental when a key is pressed.
paramNotes.kick: phase scramble applied on key press, proportional to the size of the jump.
